summary: Add to cart block for Buy Box with button and optional quantity picker.
shortDescription: The Add to Cart block provides the essential purchase action within the Buy Box. It combines an add-to-cart button with an optional quantity picker, enabling customers to select quantities before adding items. The button inherits theme styling but can be fully customized in appearance. Margin controls allow proper spacing within the Buy Box layout. This block is required for any product page where direct cart additions are needed.
